No `packages/spec`, no governed surface.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) (three new fields on `sys_comment`; nothing removed; the seat runs the declaration-face L2)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `78f7160e`, file `build-seat1/36071/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds; `sys_comment` has `parent_id`, mentions and an edited flag, and no resolved state.
Basis: card #36071; epic #36062.
Scope, the seat's reading: `is_resolved` (default false, so no migration), `resolved_by` and `resolved_at` (readonly, stamped by the platform, client values dropped); top-level only, a reply refused with 400; a reply to a resolved thread reopens it; no activity entries (the comment's own audit rows stay, as ruled on #30213); the resolved filter and the unresolved-thread count as one SQL query each; field names and query shapes in the PR body for #36075.
Two points wait on the maintainer and are not built until answered: (1) who may mark and unmark: the card's "same gate as posting" lets a reader of the record flip `is_resolved` on someone else's comment, a new narrow write; (2) "involving me": computed in phase 1 on the thread set the panel already loads, with the cross-record server query left to phase 2. Both were the coordinating seat's additions; the seat reviews them first and then asks the maintainer.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36074 edits the same plugin in parallel; `overlap-check.mjs` before each push, and the second to land merges main. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #36071`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T13:26Z · #36071 item 2 (who may mark a thread resolved and unresolve it)

The maintainer (os-sales) chose option A on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-21T13:25Z: **anyone who can see the record may mark a thread resolved and unresolve it**, the same gate as posting a comment. This is a deliberate, narrow permission widening: a reader may flip `is_resolved` on someone else's top-level comment. Every other field still needs the author or a record editor, the platform stamps who resolved it and when, and any reply reopens the thread. It was reviewed by fable before the card (`build-seat1/36071/fable-permission-involved.md` in the project folder). The card's "no change to comment read/write rules" line is read as "no other change".

The same review settled item 5 as an implementation choice with no ruling needed: "involving me" (started, replied, or mentioned) is computed in phase 1 on the thread set the comment panel already loads, with the rule stated in the PR body and tested. A cross-record server query is phase 2's to decide.
